import numpy as np

K = np.array([20.0, 25.0, 32.0, 40.0, 50.0, 63.0, 80.0, 100.0])

A = np.where(np.arange(8)[:, None] < np.arange(8)[None, :], 0.5, np.where(np.arange(8)[:, None] > np.arange(8)[None, :], 0.1, 1.0))
initial = base.copy()
n_states = 8
assert np.allclose(ricker_trajectory(initial, r, K, A, n_states), target)

assert np.allclose(trajectory_dissimilarity(dissimilarity, target_states, reference_states), target)
